description: This file defines the TempNameExpression class, which is part of Twig's internal expression handling system. It manages temporary name generation, validation, and compilation within Twig template parsing.

classes.name: TempNameExpression
classes.description: Represents a temporary name expression used internally by Twig during template compilation to manage variable names and scope.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a TempNameExpression, validating and processing the provided name, and raising errors for invalid names.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the expression into PHP code, generating a variable name based on the context.
